1.text: 1. If I had time, I would hanged out with my friends.

2.text: 2. Instead of relying on intuition, I look more for data and real details.

3.text: 3. My decisions are usually based on logic and analysis, not emotion.

4.text: 4. I prefer to have a plan for my work in advance, rather than improvising.

5.text: 5. Being with others energizes me, not exhausts me.

6.text: 6. Most of the time, I prefer tangible facts to hypothetical ideas.

7.text: 7. I always try to be fair and reasonable, even if it upsets someone.

8.text: 8. I like to know what's going to happen and have everything under control.

9.text: 9. Being in a group makes me happier and more lively.

10.text: 10. I trust more in things that are observable and measurable.

11.text: 11. I prefer to speak the truth, even if it's uncomfortable.

12.text: 12. When I have a project, I schedule everything precisely.

13.text: 13. After a long day, being around people takes away my tiredness.

14.text: 14. Instead of weaving theories, I try to understand everything in practice.

15.text: 15. Decision-making should be based on logic, not personal emotions.

16.text: 16. Planning is important to me because it gives me a sense of security and order.

17.text: 17. I don't get much energy when I'm alone, I recharge more in groups.

18.text: 18. I'm looking for things that are proven and have been tried before.

19.text: 19. If someone makes a mistake, I first look at the logical reasons for it.

20.text: 20. When I'm gonna do something, I plan the route in advance.

21.text: 21. Most of the time, it's not me who starts the conversation, but I like to stay in it.

22.text: 22. I'm interested in things that I can touch and that are real.

23.text: 23. If someone's feelings are contrary to reality, I prefer reality.

24.text: 24. Before I start anything, I like to know where it will end.

25.text: 25. It's easy for me to connect with new people.

26.text: 26. Rather than imagination, I'm more interested in measurable facts.

27.text: 27. I prefer justice to empathy when I have to choose.

28.text: 28. I don't feel good when something happens without planning.

29.text: 29. Being in a group inspires me.

30.text: 30. I would rather see the facts than look for hidden things.

31.text: 31. When I judge, I want my judgment to be logically correct.

32.text: 32. A regular plan for the future gives me a sense of control and confidence.
